Independent finite check enumerated all subsets of the forward edges incident with the two new points, for every gap placement and n=0..5; retained only edge sets containing the endpoint edge of every two-edge path. Per-placement counts matched both formulas. Totals were 4,42,260,1280,5606,23070, with the stated comparable splits.
correctness.rationale: Finite induced extensions of the fixed named antichain are realizable by the Fraïssé extension property, and their diagrams identify complete types by ultrahomogeneity. At gap i the legal unary count u_i=2^i+2^(n-i)-1 excludes a nonempty subset on both sides, which would compare old points. Each such type has arbitrarily many realizations, since copies in the same gap can be kept mutually incomparable; summing gives U_n. For x<y, fix l,m,r old points left, middle and right. Incomparable x,y permit otherwise independent unary choices except the middle witness x≺a≺y, giving J=u_l u_(l+m)-2^(l+r)(4^m-3^m). With x≺y, allowed left/middle/right local status alphabets have sizes 3/4/3. If there is neither an old point below x nor an old point above y, no old-vertex comparison is forced and one gets 2^(l+r)4^m choices. If some old point is below x, then no right parameter can have an incidence; middle parameters may only be unrelated or below y. The dual case is disjoint and yields, in total, H=2^(l+r)4^m+(3^l+3^r-2^l-2^r)2^m. These restrictions account for every length-two transitivity condition; the rest follow from these. As a separate summation check, put S_b=sum_(m=0)^n (n-m+1)2^(n-m)b^m. Then I_n=U_n^2+sum_i u_i^2-2(S_4-S_3), with S_4=4·4^n-(n+3)2^n and S_3=9·3^n-(2n+8)2^n. Also C_n=2S_4+4[z^n]((1-3z)^(-1)-(1-2z)^(-1))/((1-2z)(1-z)), where the coefficient applies to the entire rational difference. This gives the displayed closed forms, including (2,2,4) at n=0. The leading terms 8·4^n, (32/3)4^n and U_n~4·2^n give 3/7, 4/7 and 7/6 under the asserted type-counting conventions.
residual_risks: Finite verification is supplementary; exact transitivity classification and summation, not finite data, establish the universal result. No interpretation as a probability on random realized elements.

value.rationale: Adding a named linear extension to a standard homogeneous poset changes how finite partial-order types are weighted by possible gaps. The exact enumeration measures that effect: comparability changes from the pure-poset limit 1/2 to 3/7, while the complete pair count is asymptotically 7/6 of the square of the single-point count. These are usable invariants for comparing the structure and its reduct, with a complete natural base family rather than an isolated small case.
residual_risks: No claim concerning higher arity, arbitrary bases, or probabilities on realized pairs.
